name: gooey
description: Working knowledge for the gooey repo, as skills and hooks rather than oral tradition: how to verify a change across every nested module (discovered, never enumerated), how to write a component without silently breaking damage tracking, how to write a test that can actually fail, how to capture a demo under a pty, and how to land a PR through a review gate that fails open. Six checks across two hook scripts, three of them blocking, each aimed at a mistake this repo has actually shipped.
